basic_info.description: Welcome to 2507 30th Ave, a stunning Marina-Style home nestled on a quiet block in the highly desirable Parkside neighborhood. Boasting an abundance of natural light and inviting living space, this recently updated home offers a total of 4 bedrooms plus office/flex room, 3.5 bathrooms, and an ideal floor plan for modern city living. The main level features 3 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, and chef's kitchen with stainless steel appliances & Quartz countertops. The lower level includes 1 bedroom with an office/flex room, kitchenette, and spacious living area, providing endless possibilities for hosting guests, working from home, or multi-generational living. Enjoy breathtaking ocean views and relax or entertain in the spacious backyard, ideal for BBQs and bonfires. Additionally this home is equipped with 2-car parking, solar panels, and proximity to restaurants & shopping on Taraval, Parkside Square Park, Stern Grove, and more. This beautiful home offers a perfect blend of comfort, style, and convenience. Don't miss the chance to make it yours!
